defects: Gold is stated for an arbitrary ray starting at N : ℕ (AntitoneOn on Ici N, summable of f(n+N), nonneg/integrability on Ioi N); produced hardcodes N = 0, losing the generality of the theorem (it is at best the N=0 special case, not the same proposition).

Produced's nonneg hypothesis (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) requires nonnegativity on all of ℝ, strictly stronger/more restrictive than gold's hypothesis which only requires nonnegativity on Ioi N (i.e. Ioi 0 in the N=0 case).
Produced's antitone hypothesis uses Ioi 0 (open ray) instead of gold's Ici N = Ici 0 (closed ray including the endpoint) for the N=0 case, an inconsistent domain choice relative to gold's pattern.
